title: Replacement Shipments and Proof of Delivery — Wound Care Supply Program
content:
# Replacement shipments and proof of delivery — Wound Care Supply Program

Customer care guidance from the distribution centers on replacing dressing packages and on the carrier's proof of delivery.

## General terms of a replacement

A replacement ships at no charge, draws no authorized units and is never billed to a payer; it is recorded against the original shipment it replaces, and its quantity never exceeds the units of that original shipment that were lost, damaged, not received or defective.

## Replacement by situation

| Situation | When it is replaced | How |
|---|---|---|
| **Lost in transit** — no proof of delivery is on file for the package and the carrier trace period, in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays), has passed after the carrier's expected delivery date | always | expedited at no charge; it does not count toward any courtesy limit, because Larkfield bears the risk until delivery |
| **Damaged in transit** | when the customer reports the damage no later than the damage report window, in calendar days, after the delivery date on the proof of delivery for that package, counted from that delivery date with the last day allowed | a later damage report is not replaced |
| **Delivered but not received** — the proof of delivery shows the package delivered and the customer reports it not received | as a courtesy only while the program's courtesy reships over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date are fewer than the courtesy reship allowance | beyond that the customer may buy the item at the cash price or wait for the next eligible refill |
| **Defective as shipped** — the wrong type or size, a broken sterile pouch or a recalled lot | when reported no later than the defect report window, in calendar days, after the delivery date | replaced as a product defect |

## Counting courtesy reships

The courtesy reships of a program are counted over the 365 calendar days ending on and including the reship date being considered: the count is the program's replacement shipments whose reason is delivered but not received and whose ship date falls in that window.

*Hypothetical case, allowance of 1.* The program's only earlier courtesy reship shipped 2025-10-10. For a reship considered on 2026-10-09 the window runs 2025-10-10 through 2026-10-09, the count is 1, which is not fewer than 1, so no courtesy reship is made. For a reship considered on 2026-10-10 the window runs 2025-10-11 through 2026-10-10, the count is 0, so the courtesy reship may be made.

## Damage report window (hypothetical figures)

Delivery date on the proof of delivery 2026-05-04, damage report window of 7 days: a damage report made on 2026-05-11 is replaced (the last day is allowed); a report made on 2026-05-12 is not replaced.

## Proof of delivery

A proof of delivery is recorded as received from the carrier, with a signature where the tier or item requires signature on delivery, and it fixes the delivery date that return, damage and warranty windows count from; a package without a proof of delivery has no delivery date.
